title: Leaf tissue anatomy
brief: Create a realistic Cannabis fan-leaf lamina and midrib cross-section. Label upper and lower epidermis, cuticle, palisade mesophyll, spongy mesophyll, vascular bundle with xylem and phloem orientation, supporting tissues near the midrib, and representative nonglandular/glandular trichomes. Use scale-aware microscopy styling and do not imply that every cultivar has identical tissue proportions.

title: Leaf morphogenesis & leaflet complexity
brief: Create a Cannabis leaf-development sequence from simple early true leaves to increasingly compound fan leaves and later reduced leaflet complexity near reproductive development. Use the published White Widow pattern as a labeled study example, with a prominent note that exact leaflet counts and node numbers vary by genotype and conditions.

title: Leaf age & photosynthetic capacity
brief: Compare newly fully expanded, intermediate-age, and older still-green hemp/Cannabis leaves. Show declining photosynthetic-capacity indicators as conceptual trajectories rather than universal numerical cutoffs, and distinguish leaf chronological/physiological age from canopy position and light history.

title: Stomatal traits & sampling context
brief: Show standardized epidermal sampling with leaf surface, developmental stage, genotype/ploidy, field of view, magnification, and counted area recorded. Include example stomata of different sizes/densities as study-context comparisons, not species-wide reference values.
